title: CareLine Service Plans Terms of Renewal
content:
**Renewal clauses of the CareLine Service Plans agreement.**

R1. A plan set to renew automatically rolls into a new term the day after its term end date, and the renewal fee is billed that day; the holder is told of the renewal and its fee by the renewal notice date.

R2. The renewal fee is the plan's current fee per term, never more than the renewal increase cap above the fee the holder last paid for a term before discounts.

R3. A plan held for at least the loyalty threshold of consecutive plan years receives the plan's loyalty discount on the renewal fee. The consecutive plan years are the whole plan years the plan has been held, from the enrolled date to the renewal in question, without lapsing into expired or cancelled.

R4. A renewal fee unpaid on the renewal date makes the plan past due; paid within the grace period it returns to active, and unpaid at the end of the grace period the plan expires.

R5. A plan not set to renew expires at its term end date.

R6. The holder may turn automatic renewal on or off at any time before the term end date.

The renewal increase cap, the loyalty discount and threshold, the renewal notice period, the grace period and whether a new plan starts out set to renew are the figures the product schedules set for the plan's tier.

### R2 and R3 worked through (hypothetical figures: cap 5%, loyalty discount 10%, loyalty threshold three plan years)

The fee the holder last paid for a term, before discounts, was 200.00, so the renewal fee can be at most 210.00. The loyalty discount then acts on the renewal fee.

| Plan's current fee per term | Renewal fee | Whole plan years held | Fee billed on the renewal date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 220.00 | 210.00, held at the cap | 3 | 210.00 less 10%, that is 189.00 |
| 205.00 | 205.00, under the cap | 3 | 205.00 less 10%, that is 184.50 |
| 205.00 | 205.00, under the cap | 2 | 205.00 |

### R3 on the calendar (hypothetical plan enrolled 1 June 2023, never expired or cancelled, threshold three plan years)

- Renewal on 1 June 2025: two whole plan years held — below the threshold; no loyalty discount.
- Renewal on 1 June 2026: three whole plan years held — at the threshold; the loyalty discount applies.

### R1, R4 and R5 in sequence of status (hypothetical term ending 31 May 2026)

| The plan | What happens |
|---|---|
| Set to renew automatically | A new term begins on 1 June 2026 and the renewal fee is billed on 1 June 2026 |
| Set to renew, renewal fee unpaid on 1 June 2026 | The plan becomes past due |
| Past due, renewal fee paid within the grace period | The plan returns to active |
| Past due, renewal fee still unpaid at the end of the grace period | The plan expires |
| Not set to renew | The plan expires at its term end date, 31 May 2026 |

### Points of reading

**Is the cap measured against a discounted fee?** R2 measures it against the fee the holder last paid for a term before discounts.
